name: image_generate
description: Generate a new image from a text prompt. Supports transparent backgrounds (background=transparent) and multiple output formats (png, jpeg, webp). For editing an existing image, use image_edit instead.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

provider.description: Provider connector ID (use image_providers to list available options). If omitted, the first available image generation provider is used.

model.description: Model name to use. Overrides the provider's default model. If omitted, the provider's default model is used.

output.description: Output file path for the generated image.

background.description: Background handling. Use 'transparent' for PNG/WebP images with no background. Default: auto (provider decides).

output_compression.description: Compression level 0-100 for jpeg/webp output. Higher means better quality. Default: 100.

quality.description: Image quality level. Higher quality takes longer to generate. Default: auto.

extra.description: Additional provider-specific parameters as a JSON object. These are passed directly to the provider API. Common keys: moderation (auto|low). Use for parameters not covered by the standard fields above.
